beats.summary: Dwight comments on the house's structural issues and the cocktail party.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: The chimney is in decent shape. Not great. I found some termite damage in a crawl space and some structural flaws in the foundation so all in all, it was a pretty fun cocktail party.
